title: Meeting Rooms II
statement:
Given meeting intervals `[start, end]`, return the minimum number of rooms needed so every meeting can take place. A meeting ending at time `t` does not overlap one starting at time `t`.

## Examples

```text
Input: intervals = [[0, 30], [5, 10], [15, 20]]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: intervals = [[7, 10], [2, 4]]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= intervals.length <= 10^4`
- `0 <= start < end <= 10^6`
